rules.utility: Kentucky Utilities Company (KU, a PPL company)
rules.threshold_text: Contract capacity greater than 50 MVA (the tariff states MVA, not MW) and an expected average monthly load factor above 85 percent; new customers only; the Company may aggregate accounts or facilities to apply the threshold. The threshold was 100 MVA as first proposed and was reduced to 50 MVA by the stipulation the PSC approved
rules.contract_term: Initial Contract Term of not less than 15 years; either party gives at least 60 months' advance written notice to discontinue (the notice does not shorten the initial term except through the Exit Fee); contract capacity may be reduced only after the first 5 years of the initial term, on 60 months' written notice and with a Capacity Reduction Fee
rules.collateral: Cash or letter of credit equal to 24 months of minimum billed amounts at the largest contract capacity; 12 months if the customer or its guarantor is rated at least A (S&P) and A2 (Moody's) and holds cash and cash equivalents of at least 10 times the requirement. Due at signing of the Electric Service Agreement; an increased requirement after an adverse credit change is due within three business days of written notice. Letter of credit from a bank with assets of at least 10 billion USD rated at least A- and A3
rules.exit_fee: Exit Fee on termination before the end of the Initial Contract Term (after the 60 months' notice): the nominal value of the remaining minimum non-fuel revenue over the remaining term, due on the effective date of termination. Capacity Reduction Fee: the nominal value of the remaining minimum non-fuel revenue change from the original contract capacity over the remaining term

rules.utility: DTE Electric Company
rules.threshold_text: No threshold: customer-specific special contracts; contracted maximum load of approximately 1.4 GW (the MPSC release says a 1,383 MW data center)
rules.contract_term: PSA of approximately 19 years, from Commission approval to 28 February 2045, with two optional customer renewals of ten years each; a change of rate schedule needs a request 24 months ahead and not before 24 months after the Load Ramp Completion Date. rules.exit_fee: Termination before the tenth anniversary of the Load Ramp Completion Date: minimum billing demand times the greater of the months left to that anniversary or 24 months; after it: 24 months of minimum monthly charges (designed to recover at least 10 years of minimum monthly charges)

rules.utility: Northern States Power Company, a Minnesota corporation (Xcel Energy)
rules.threshold_text: New loads of 100 MW or more; also new customers of at least 20 MW but less than 100 MW that are system intensive (needing significant system modifications, design, engineering or other expenditures before service)
rules.contract_term: 15-year default contract term (approved); in Xcel's proposed sheet the initial ESA term is at least 15 years including a Load Ramp Period of up to 5 years; 24 months' exit notice (approved)
rules.collateral: Transmission and distribution upgrades paid by the customer as contributions in aid of construction (Commission). Xcel's proposed sheet requires sufficient credit support in the ESA; its form ESA asks for a guaranty from a US guarantor with no credit rating but a cash balance over 3 billion dollars, or a rating of BBB- (S&P) or Baa3 (Moody's) or better, and on a Credit Event a cash deposit, letter of credit, surety bond or other support for the Company's credit exposure within 30 days, capped at the Guaranty Cap
rules.exit_fee: Exit fee on 80 percent of contracted capacity (the Commission raised it from Xcel's 75 percent). In Xcel's proposed sheet: termination on 24 months' notice with an exit fee equal to Effective Contract Capacity x on-peak demand charges x the percentage x the lesser of the remaining ESA months or 120 months; the same formula applies to a contract capacity reduction (12 months' notice in the form ESA)

rules.utility: Union Electric Company d/b/a Ameren Missouri
rules.contract_term: Up to five years of optional Load Ramp plus a twelve-year Term (held); the Term begins on the date permanent service begins or as the LLCS Service Agreement sets out; automatic five-year Extension Terms unless either party gives at least 36 months' written notice before the end of the Term or Extension Term; termination before the end of the Term needs a Termination Notice at least 24 months before the Termination Date
rules.collateral: Two years of Minimum Monthly Bills (held); a customer that, with any Guarantor, meets credit rating and liquidity tests is exempt from 60, 50, 40 or 25 percent of it, those discounts capped at $175 million, $150 million, $125 million and $75 million; provided at the time of executing the LLCS Service Agreement; the Company considers reductions annually once the customer has been at peak load for at least three years
rules.exit_fee: Exit Fee during and after the Ramp Period (held); in addition an Early Termination Fee of two times the Minimum Monthly Bill times the months short of the 24 months' notice; capacity may be cut by up to 20 percent in total without charge on 24 months' notice, and beyond that after the first five years of the Term on 24 months' notice subject to a Capacity Reduction Fee
